gtaiv-dxvk-vr — Drag-and-drop install (GTA IV Complete Edition)
================================================================

This pack includes:
  - Stock DXVK 3.0.2 (d3d9.dll)
  - gtaiv_dxvk_vr.asi + openvr_api.dll (SteamVR / OpenVR) — Mode 909
  - FusionFix (ASI loader dinput8.dll + plugins + update assets)
  - VR HUD layout (money → stars → ammo → weapon, radar inset toward center)
  - QUICK-START.bat and FULL-RESTART.bat

See THIRDPARTY.txt for credits. Do not redistribute Rockstar game files.


BEFORE YOU COPY
---------------
1. Own GTA IV Complete Edition (Steam).
2. Install SteamVR. Headset (e.g. Reverb G2) must work in SteamVR.
3. Close GTA IV completely.


INSTALL (drag and drop)
-----------------------
1. Open your game folder (contains GTAIV.exe), typically:

   C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Grand Theft Auto IV\GTAIV

2. OPTIONAL: back up d3d9.dll, dinput8.dll, plugins\, update\, common\data\hud.dat.

3. Copy EVERYTHING from this zip’s “drop-into-GTAIV” folder into that GTAIV folder.
   Merge folders when Windows asks. Overwrite is OK for these mod files.

4. OPTIONAL square aspect: rename commandline.txt.vr-square → commandline.txt
   (backup old commandline.txt first). Then FULL process restart once.

5. Double-click QUICK-START.bat  (or: SteamVR on → start GTA IV).

6. In FusionFix graphics options: use DirectX 9 (NOT FusionFix Vulkan).

7. In-game: F3 opens the VR menu. Log next to GTAIV.exe: gtaiv_dxvk_vr.log
   Expect buildId like 20260803-909-hud4 and Mode909.


FULL RESTART (important)
------------------------
Menu “Full restart” now quits the game and runs FULL-RESTART.bat
(real process restart). “Re-read settings files” only reloads text configs
and does NOT reload the ASI binary.


UNINSTALL / KILL
----------------
- Quick kill VR: edit gtaiv_dxvk_vr.stereo → 0 → restart (flat via DXVK).
- Remove VR only: delete gtaiv_dxvk_vr.asi and openvr_api.dll.


HOTKEYS
-------
  F3  VR settings menu (Xbox Select also toggles on recent builds)
  F5  Eye canvas resolution
  F6  Stereo scale
  F8  IPD / separation
  F9  Recenter look
  F10 Recenter seated lean baseline


IMPORTANT
---------
- FirstPerson.asi should stay OFF (rename to FirstPerson.asi.off if present).
- Win32 / x86 only. Offline / singleplayer for this WIP.
- Do not share Rockstar game assets.


See CONFIG-GUIDE.txt for config files.
